Well, mission accomplished and the good news is we can now bring all that hard work back to Steam for an even better experience here. notes.title: Content Update Coming Soon and Early Access Discount Price Ending
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/584724efbc48b6e007ce22088553469e16c9b523.png

We will be releasing our next big content update for BattleCakes this coming Monday, January 29th!

What to expect in the upcoming build?

In addition to the content updates which includes:

 New location! The desert town of West Garnish, the Whistling Gorge, the crystal mines and more.
 New NPCs! Meet the colorful cast of West Garnish and the visitors to the West Garnish Gemboree.
 New Dangers! Delve into the crystal mines of the West Garnish Dungeon and continue your pursuit of Lord Fondant.

There will also be:

 Controller Re-mapping!
 Updated default keyboard controls
 Quest UI improvements
 Save Slot UI improvements
 And more...

Please note: With the upcoming build, we will also be ending the discounted Early Access pricing and the game will go up to the full release price of $19.99 (USD).

Thank you to all our players and can't wait to hear what you think of the next area! There's only one more town to go after this one and then the final battle awaits! We're getting closer and closer to release, so please share your thoughts and feedback! We appreciate you! 🙂

notes.title: BattleCakes releasing in Early Access this Thursday
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/99eafe34c8a955be17a7b13b2cad86434711f45f.gif

Nobody likes a half baked cupcake...

Hi everyone, we just wanted to give you an update on how we are launching BattleCakes a little differently than expected this week. We're a very small team that has been developing BattleCakes for a few years now, and we’re super excited for you to play it! We had planned to launch the full game this Thursday October 26th, but we’ve realized that launching the full game now would not only force our team into an unhealthy crunch cycle, but also risk not offering the quality gameplay experience that we’ve aimed for.

That said, we feel it's important to be open about how messy and complicated it is for humans like us to make even a cute little game. We love BattleCakes so much, and we hope that you do too — that’s why we’re releasing into Early Access now. This way, you can start playing it sooner, and we can schedule the final development of the full game in a way that keeps our team healthy, and our game what we dreamed it could be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/6711d0d5986448f143e6d99fb2d855eb5a35dd16.gif

How long will BattleCakes be in Early Access?

BattleCakes will enter Early Access on October 26th, 2023. We hope to be in Early Access for about 3 months and will be releasing our first bi-weekly content update on November 9th,  but that might shift a bit — we’re planning to be a little flexible to make sure that your feedback is prioritized during the final development phase.

Bug fixes will be released as needed through out the Early Access period and we will be posting frequent timeline updates on Steam. 

What’s the current state of the Early Access game?

BattleCakes currently has all major systems in place. About a third of the game is currently playable in Early Access — The first two major towns, their dungeons and the surrounding landscapes are ready for
exploration! There are also a handful of player actions, items, crafting recipes and toppers that will be expanded during the final stage of
development. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37561839/5e6d4f3b0596539d57ca5afe0b118aabab4f58f6.gif

Will there be a price difference during Early Access?

Yes! We're reducing the price to $14.99 for those supporting the game in Early Access. It'll be full price at $19.99 once all additional content has been added and we get to the game's full release.

How will you involve the player community?

We want your feedback! Our community on both Steam and Discord will help inform and improve development decisions as we wrap up the game and head toward final release on Steam and Xbox early next year.
